working_definition: Cells of the authors' neural clusters (Ing-Simmons et al. 2021, Fig. 2): neural1 with neuroblast / ganglion mother cell markers (wor, pros, insb, nerfin-1, scrt), neural2 with neuronal markers (chinmo, Appl, Rdl); control embryos at 2.5-3.5 h.
justification: FBbt has no cell-level term for a generic embryonic neural cell (neuroectoderm and the neurogenic regions are tissues); embryonic neuroblast would go beyond the authors' typing, and neural2's markers are neuronal. Held (curator 2026-10-18).
